title: Reading In Early Chilhood And Primary Education
modules: Nature Of Reading At The Primary Level
Approaches, Methods & Techniques Of Teaching Reading
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as the level of understanding of a passage or text."
Reading comprehension can be defined as the level of understanding of a passage or text.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of being aware of understanding."
Comprehension monitoring is the process of being aware of understanding.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mechanical process leading learners to habit formation whose underlying scheme is the conditioned reflex."
learning is a mechanical process leading learners to habit formation whose underlying scheme is the conditioned reflex.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a letter or note written to the children before they arrive for instruction or while they are present, that provides insight into content of instruction and upcoming events in the class."

Morning message is a letter or note written to the children before they arrive for instruction or while they are present, that provides insight into content of instruction and upcoming events in the class.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the productive skill in the oral mode; the delivery of language through the mouth."
Speaking is the productive skill in the oral mode; the delivery of language through the mouth.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the key to unlocking the author's intent and combining it with the reader's own background knowledge."
Questioning the Author This strategy is the key to unlocking the author's intent and combining it with the reader's own background knowledge.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a compilation of reading and writing samples collected over a period of weeks or months."
Portfolio assessment Portfolio assessment is a compilation of reading and writing samples collected over a period of weeks or months.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the observations, record keeping, and ongoing performance tests that a teacher uses to gather information about each pupil's reading progress (Flippo, 2003)."
Reading assessment refers to the observations, record keeping, and ongoing performance tests that a teacher uses to gather information about each pupil's reading progress (Flippo, 2003).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the solid foundation on which almost all subsequent learning takes place and all children need this foundation."
Beginning reading is the solid foundation on which almost all subsequent learning takes place and all children need this foundation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a more structured interaction between the teacher and an individual pupil."
Interviewing (and sometime questionnaire) is a more structured interaction between the teacher and an individual pupil.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a technique that promotes critical thinking by encouraging pupils to apply reading strategies to learn from content-area texts."
The I-Chart Procedure is a technique that promotes critical thinking by encouraging pupils to apply reading strategies to learn from content-area texts.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the fact that good readers tend to read much more than weak readers."
The Matthew Effect refers to the fact that good readers tend to read much more than weak readers.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of restating the text in different words, or in the reader's own words."
Paraphrasing is the process of restating the text in different words, or in the reader's own words.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the best way to give children the tools they'll need to become good readers, listeners, and pupils."
Research shows that reading aloud is the best way to give children the tools they'll need to become good readers, listeners, and pupils.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the receptive skill in the written mode."
Reading is the receptive skill in the written mode.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of using symbols (letters of the alphabet, punctuation and spaces) to communicate thoughts and ideas in a readable form."
Writing is the process of using symbols (letters of the alphabet, punctuation and spaces) to communicate thoughts and ideas in a readable form.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tool that measures a learner's knowledge and ability."
Assessment is a tool that measures a learner's knowledge and ability.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a Universal Grammar, which contains all the basic rules (grammar) that underlie all human languages."
Within the LAD is a Universal Grammar, which contains all the basic rules (grammar) that underlie all human languages.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of linking ideas and understanding the relations between separate sentences in the text."
Bridging inferences is the process of linking ideas and understanding the relations between separate sentences in the text.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a particularly difficult problem when children are not provided with the necessary materials for lessons and class sizes are very large."
Discipline is a particularly difficult problem when children are not provided with the necessary materials for lessons and class sizes are very large.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most important assets that humans have - the ability to communicate with one another allows us to learn and share complex ideas."
Oral language is one of the most important assets that humans have - the ability to communicate with one another allows us to learn and share complex ideas.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an essential component of educational process, and the books and other materials serve to promote learning with emphasis on reading among pupils and members of staff."
The library is an essential component of educational process, and the books and other materials serve to promote learning with emphasis on reading among pupils and members of staff.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a developed ability to construct meaning effectively, immediately, and effortlessly with little conscious attention."
reading comprehension skill is a developed ability to construct meaning effectively, immediately, and effortlessly with little conscious attention.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a mental state and the structure of a language doesn't make it a language; it is the function of speaking words that makes a language a language."
Knowledge (of language) is a mental state and the structure of a language doesn't make it a language; it is the function of speaking words that makes a language a language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are an asset that will promote a lifetime of effective communication."
Strong language skills are an asset that will promote a lifetime of effective communication.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a short description of interaction between a child and the adult."
PEER is a short description of interaction between a child and the adult.
fib: ______ means simply that each person involved in the dialogue acts in response to the others.
Reciprocal
Reciprocal means simply that each person involved in the dialogue acts in response to the others.
______ is one of the main teaching techniques used at all levels of school from new entrants through to form two classes.
Guided silent reading
Guided Silent Reading Guided silent reading is one of the main teaching techniques used at all levels of school from new entrants through to form two classes.
______ are derived from a base alphabet of 26 letters.
Thousands of words
Thousands of words are derived from a base alphabet of 26 letters.
______ is an example of writing for one's self.
Taking notes while studying
Taking notes while studying is an example of writing for one's self.
______ refers to how the child understands, organizes, speaks and uses words and this can be divided into two categories: receptive language and expressive language.
Language development
Language development refers to how the child understands, organizes, speaks and uses words and this can be divided into two categories: receptive language and expressive language.
______ is one of the most important of all developmental tasks, because school success is predicated on reading success.
Learning to read
Learning to read is one of the most important of all developmental tasks, because school success is predicated on reading success.
______ means more than just having books and writing materials on hand.
literate home
A literate home means more than just having books and writing materials on hand.
______ refers to the five types of questions asked by adults when engaging in dialogic reading with children.
CROWD
CROWD refers to the five types of questions asked by adults when engaging in dialogic reading with children.
______ is one of the most accessible forms of assessment for a teacher.
Observations Observing pupils
Observations Observing pupils is one of the most accessible forms of assessment for a teacher.
______ is one of the key elements in enhancing children's progress in learning to read.
classroom environment
The classroom environment is one of the key elements in enhancing children's progress in learning to read.
______ is the culmination of mastering vocabulary, phonics, fluency, and reading comprehension skills (Dougherty-Stahl, 2004).
Effective reading comprehension
Effective reading comprehension is the culmination of mastering vocabulary, phonics, fluency, and reading comprehension skills (Dougherty-Stahl, 2004).
______ refers to knowledge about the topic of the text such as knowledge about science, history, or about specific topics, such as cell mitosis, heat exchange, or World War II.
Domain knowledge
Domain knowledge refers to knowledge about the topic of the text such as knowledge about science, history, or about specific topics, such as cell mitosis, heat exchange, or World War II.
______ is defined as an overt process consciously selected and used by a reader to aid the process of constructing meaning more effectively and efficiently.
reading comprehension strategy
A reading comprehension strategy is defined as an overt process consciously selected and used by a reader to aid the process of constructing meaning more effectively and efficiently.
______ is an indispensable and overriding factor for effective communication.
Vocabulary knowledge
Vocabulary knowledge is an indispensable and overriding factor for effective communication.
______ is one of the essential components to gain fluency in speaking performance.
knowledge
knowledge is one of the essential components to gain fluency in speaking performance.
______ is the basis upon which all human languages build.
Universal Grammar
The Universal Grammar is the basis upon which all human languages build.
______ is a staple in most reading-focused classrooms, from Kindergarten through high school.
K-W-L chart
The K-W-L chart is a staple in most reading-focused classrooms, from Kindergarten through high school.
______ is the most powerful tool in the development of any human being.
Language
Language is the most powerful tool in the development of any human being.
______ are those who are constantly monitoring their understanding of the text as they read it.
Independent readers
Independent readers are those who are constantly monitoring their understanding of the text as they read it.
______ is an end that a person tries to reach.
goal
A goal is an end that a person tries to reach.
______ is a continuous assessment component of your course.
TMA
The TMA is a continuous assessment component of your course.
______ is the ability to connect what is in the text with what is in the mind to create an educated guess.
inference
An inference is the ability to connect what is in the text with what is in the mind to create an educated guess.
______ means that sufficient time, used wisely and with high pupil engagement, is provided direct instruction for pupils to master the reading skills and strategies they need.
Intensive reading instruction
Intensive reading instruction means that sufficient time, used wisely and with high pupil engagement, is provided direct instruction for pupils to master the reading skills and strategies they need.
______ is an active process in which the reader calls on experience, language, and prior knowledge to anticipate and understand the author's written language.
Fluent reading
Fluent reading is an active process in which the reader calls on experience, language, and prior knowledge to anticipate and understand the author's written language.
______ is a specific reading and/or learning disability due to a defect in the brain's processing of graphic symbols, i.e. it alters the way the brain processes written material.
Dyslexia
Dyslexia is a specific reading and/or learning disability due to a defect in the brain's processing of graphic symbols, i.e. it alters the way the brain processes written material.

Advocates of this approach sometimes

Advocates of this approach sometimes refer to it as the top-down process as it focuses on the readers whose minds are not blank, but bring information based on past experience with language and their world to the act of reading.
